matthew-matias.text: Matias's campaign lists as a position: "Support parent and school choice while keeping each student's educational needs at the center of the decision."

source.title: Matthew Matias for FJUHSD Trustee Area 1 (2026)

matthew-matias.text: His campaign site promotes Opt-Out CA, a parent-facing opt-out notice covering student privacy, records, data and surveys, under the heading "Know your options and rights."

source.title: Matthew Matias for FJUHSD Trustee Area 1 (2026)

matthew-matias.text: Matias says he would strengthen pathways to college, career technical education, skilled trades, military service, business and entrepreneurship, and add financial literacy so students gain skills for independence.

source.title: Matthew Matias for FJUHSD Trustee Area 1 (2026)

matthew-matias.text: Matias lists "Transparency and fiscal responsibility" as a priority: board decisions should be understandable, "public resources responsibly managed, and accountability connected to student outcomes."

source.title: Matthew Matias for FJUHSD Trustee Area 1 (2026)

notes: Matthew Matias has a detailed campaign site. Regina Cuadra (a 2018 Area 1 candidate) has no findable 2026 site or positions; her Donorbox page is unavailable. A conservative voter guide (Nancy's Picks) recommends Matias and says Cuadra is Democratic Party-endorsed, but that could not be confirmed from a party source, so it is not used. Searches used: 10
